Why guessing is no fun

Right now, you're playing with no score.

Imagine playing a game where nobody tells you the score, the rules are a secret, and your only coach just says “great job!” no matter what. That's how most of us learned this. No wonder it feels like guesswork.

1

He's too sweet to score you

Your partner says “that was great” because he's kind — even on an off day. Sweet? Yes. Helpful for getting better? Not really. You're left guessing what actually worked.

2

Videos can't cheer you on

A video shows you what to do, then leaves you alone with it. It can't spot your speed wobbling, your suction fading, or you getting close to gagging — and it never says “YES, that round was your best yet!”

3

Learning live is awkward

Trying something brand new while he's right there, watching? The pressure kills the fun — and the learning. Practise first, giggle through the wobbly rounds at home, then show up feeling like a pro.

“Give a skill a score, and suddenly practice feels like play.”

Try a round, see your points, tweak one little thing, beat your score. That loop is addictive in the best way — it's how games keep you coming back, and it's exactly how this trainer works.

How it works

Set it up once. Then practise for 15 mins.

There is no test and no rush. You choose when to start, when to pause, and when to stop.

1
STEP 1 · DO THIS ONCE

Find your gag limit

Go very slowly. Find the depth where you first feel you may gag. The trainer saves this and sets your Green / Yellow / Red zones. From then on, everything is based on your body — not on anyone else.

2
STEP 2 · 3 TIMES A WEEK

Play your rounds

15-minute rounds with live charts, a gentle buzz before the red zone, and a score at the end that dares you to beat it next time. Wobbly first rounds are part of the game — everyone starts somewhere, and the only way is up.

3
STEP 3 · ONLY WHEN YOU ARE READY

Be with your partner

When you feel ready — and only then — try what you learned with him. You can pick what he likes best, and use his words to plan your next practice.

The 4-week game plan — 4 levels

Free with every trainer. Finish a level, unlock the next, and watch your score grow week by week. If you need more time on a level, take it — that is fine. This is your game, at your pace.

Level 1 · Week 1

Start gently — you are on the board!

Find your gag limit and your first scores. Learn a steady speed at a depth that feels easy. No pressure — just see where you start.

Most women start at 45–60 out of 100
Level 2 · Week 2

Speed and suction — find “just right”

Keep a steady speed for a full 2 mins. Keep suction in “Just right” — not too soft, not too strong — even at the end.

Goal: speed and suction both over 18 out of 25
Level 3 · Week 3

Depth, slowly — a little further

Stay in the yellow zone for 10 seconds at a time. Go a little deeper, slowly. Try not to gag — feeling in control comes first.

Goal: go 1–2 cm deeper, gag less and less
Level 4 · Week 4

Put it all together — your best round yet

Full practice using what your partner likes, all 5 skills at once. Then, when you feel ready, try it with him.

Goal: finish at 75–88 out of 100

The honest truth

What it can do — and what it cannot do.

We would rather lose a sale than lie to you. Here is the full truth, before you book.

What it can do

  • Help you practise speed, suction and depth, with clear scores, over 4 to 6 weeks
  • Help you gag less, slowly and safely, at your own pace — you can stop any time
  • Help you feel more sure of yourself, by practising alone with no one watching or judging you
  • Help you learn what your partner likes — not one fixed way for everyone

What it cannot do

  • Teach you how to show you want it, look at him, talk to him, or read his body — that part is human, and it matters a lot
  • Promise he will cum — his mood, stress and health matter too
  • Take the place of being with a real partner — that is why the plan includes it, when you feel ready
  • Help someone who is already very skilled get much better — women who are new or in the middle will gain the most

For helpers and first testers

Help us decide if we should make it at all.

We want to talk to 20 women. Each chat is 15 mins, with no names written down. If someone sent you this page to help with a chat, all the questions are below. Ask them in order. Do not try to sell until Question 5. Write down her exact words for Question 2 — they help us most.

Questions for the chat — 15 mins

Start with: “I am learning about a new training product. I have 5 questions. No names. I will not link your name to anything you say. Is that okay?”

Paste into a doc to print
1
First check

“Have you ever wished you were better at blowjobs, or felt more sure doing it?”

Yes / No — just write it down. Do not react.

Why we ask: To see if this is a real problem for her. If she says no, thank her warmly — she is not a buyer, and that is good to know too.
2
What holds her back · Write her exact words

“What makes it hard for you now? Gagging? Not knowing if he likes it? Your speed? Your teeth?”

Let her answer first, before you give examples. Write her exact words — do not change them.

Why we ask: Her own words help us write this page in words women really use, and choose which skill to put first.
3
What she has tried before

“Have you ever bought a course, a book, or a toy to help you get better at it?”

What was it, and how much did it cost? If she only used free videos, write that down too.

Why we ask: What a woman has paid for before tells us most about what she may pay for next.
4
Would she pay?

“If there was a private trainer that gave you a score and told you, in a kind way, what to work on, would you pay $99–149 for it?”

Yes / No / Maybe — if Maybe, ask: “What would make it a yes for you?”

Why we ask: This shows interest, but it is not proof on its own — that is why Question 5 matters.
5
The real test

“Would you pay a $10 deposit today to book one at $99 — and get the $10 back if we do not ship it?”

Yes / No. If yes, send her the book link on this page while you are still talking.

Why we ask: 5 or more yes answers out of 20 chats means real demand. If most women say “free videos are enough”, we should stop and think again.

How to read the answers

  • Good sign: 12 or more of 20 say Yes to Q1 and Q4, and 5 or more say Yes to Q5 → make it.
  • Bad sign: Most say “I would just watch a free video” → free videos are enough for them; do not make the trainer.
  • Last words: “Thank you so much — if we launch, your link holds the $99 price. Either way, you really helped us.”

Questions

Things you may be wondering.

Is it actually fun, or does it feel like homework?

Fun — that's the whole design. Every round ends with a score, small wins get celebrated, badges unlock as you improve, and each week opens a new level. Most practice games work because beating your own best is addictive. This one just happens to make you amazing at something much more interesting than a puzzle game.

Can I really share it with friends?

Yes — please do! Every week you get a pretty score card you can drop into the group chat, and the 4-Week Girlfriends' Challenge gives you a friendly leaderboard to climb together. You only ever share the score card you choose to send — nothing is posted for you, ever.

Is my data private, and will anyone know I bought it?

Your scores stay on your own phone, there's no account, and no photos or videos are ever taken. It arrives in a plain box with a plain name on your bank bill. What you share with friends is entirely up to you — that's the fun part.

How do I clean it?

Take the soft cover off and wash it with mild soap and water. The base never goes in your mouth — just wipe it clean. If the cover tears, stop using it and ask us for a new one.

What if you do not make it?

You get your $10 back in full. The deposit is only to check if enough women want this. If not enough women book, we do not make it, and you get your money back. No forms, no fight.

Is this safe?

The trainer is made of safe, soft silicone and plugs in by USB. Gag practice is slow by design: stay just below your limit for 10 seconds, never push, and stop at once if you feel sick. You can stop any time. This is a training aid to help you learn — it is not a medical tool.

Who is it for?

Women aged 18+ who want to feel more sure and more skilled — most of all if you are new to this, feel nervous, gag easily, or just want kind, private feedback. If you are already very skilled, your gains will be smaller — see the honest truth above.

Can I talk about it with my friends?

Yes — and lots of women want to! You get a score card each week that you can share with close friends, only if you want to. Try the 4-Week Girlfriends' Challenge: you each practise alone at home, then share scores and cheer each other on. No photos, no videos, and no details you do not want to share. It is always your choice.

When will it ship?

Our goal is within 90 days after we reach our booking goal. We will email you before we take the last $89 — and you can cancel then and still get your deposit back.
